protocol.population: All originally selected I and C galaxies with canonical clean_s123 HSC g renders; do not prefilter with the historical 74- or 62-region eligibility lists.

measurement.resolution: native HSC observation and HSC-rendered prediction; no additional smoothing
measurement.pixel_weights: exact fractional pixel overlap with circular apertures on the local HSC WCS
measurement.background_estimator: separate 3-sigma-clipped median for each image, maximum 5 iterations; no data-minus-model background
measurement.rejection_basis: HSC masks, finite data and positive variance, annular coverage, observed flux, supplied-PSF approximation quality; never ratio or residual quality
measurement.shared_pixel_support: Apply the same valid-pixel mask and aperture weights to observation and prediction. No imputation or area correction for masked pixels.
measurement.sensitivity_population: Use the primary accepted galaxies; record separately any failing the 3-arcsec measurement cuts and report paired 6- and 3-arcsec summaries for the remaining common set.
measurement.summary: Unweighted median and 25th/75th percentiles of per-region predicted/observed aperture flux, separately by group; record every exclusion. No outlier clipping of ratios.

calibration.existing_conversion: Rendered observed arrays include the local supplied PSF fraction within 12 pixels; predictions use a unit-integral PSF.
calibration.decision_rule: Check the PDR3 calibration convention independently of prediction agreement. Preserve the existing factor if supported; never choose a convention to make ratios closer to unity.
calibration.if_unresolved: Generate both retained-factor and header-only diagnostics, label the calibration ambiguity explicitly, and do not present a confirmed percent-level calibration claim.

implementation_choices_and_rationale.radius: 6 arcsec chosen by the author; 3 arcsec is a predeclared sensitivity check, not an alternative selected by agreement.
implementation_choices_and_rationale.annulus_and_thresholds: Retain the existing 22-28 arcsec annulus, 95-percent aperture coverage, 100 background pixels and 5-percent PSF-L1 quality thresholds. Recompute them for the new aperture and independent backgrounds.
implementation_choices_and_rationale.background_masking: Exclude HSC-detected source pixels in the background annulus and use standard 3-sigma clipping to reduce contaminating sources; both images are treated independently on the same initial observed-mask support.
implementation_choices_and_rationale.no_total_flux_claim: This measures light in catalog-centered regions, including any neighboring light; it does not estimate deblended total galaxy flux.

calibration.access: Authenticated read-only request to the HSC PDR3 data access service.
calibration.finding: FLUXMAG0 calibrates stellar counts within a 12-pixel-radius aperture. The manual instructs multiplying a raw total-flux measurement by the PSF flux fraction within that aperture to obtain the calibrated flux scale. This is the factor already applied to the saved observed arrays. It must not be applied a second time.
calibration.measurement_interpretation: The same pixel-to-flux conversion puts observed aperture light on the unit-integral PSF convention of the renderer. It does not extrapolate the measured 6- or 3-arcsec galaxy aperture to total galaxy light.
calibration.implementation: external-artifact:render_hsc.py, psf_fit: psf[radius <= 12].sum() / psf.sum(); observed_factor includes this fraction. The new analysis verifies this against the original FITS pixels and reports the per-object factor.
calibration.secondary_diagnostic: header_only ratios deliberately omit the required factor and are stored solely to expose its numerical effect, not as an alternative calibration selected for better agreement.

regrouping.rule: Retain the frozen imaging-only sample. Retain original controls only with a canonical fitted fiber within 1 arcsec. Exclude failures without reassignment. Per-object photometry and original selection labels are unchanged.
